description: The Fleaflicker league's strategy (Settings/leagues/beagles.json): strategy.json with the live choices: adddrop.tail = 'cost' (a swap must also cover the rest-of-season value it loses; seat-paired on 2024-25 neutral, +0.21 +/- 0.40 pts/wk pooled) and streaming.mode = 'week' (Decisions/weekplan.py; +2.01 +/- 0.62 pts/wk, 2024-25, 16 drafts); and streaming.gate = true with streaming.next_week = 1.0 -- on the week's last day with the week won (P(win) >= 0.9), a pickup is priced on next week alone. The user's call for a league that streams heavily (2026-09-27): in the 2024-25 backtest it cost -1.45 +/- 0.62 pts/wk (win rate +0.007 +/- 0.013, 8 drafts); the backtest's leaguemates may not stream like this league's. streaming.goalies = true (goalie rentals, starting goalies protected; priced on tonight's simulated line; 2024-25, 32 drafts, +0.70 +/- 0.41 pts/wk, win +0.013 +/- 0.006; the user's call 2026-09-27). streaming.spots = 99, i.e. no limit: every rostered player below replacement may be streamed, each rental still clearing its drop cost (2024-25, 32 drafts, +2.08 +/- 0.49 pts/wk, win +0.016 +/- 0.007, both halves positive; the user's call 2026-09-27). streaming.spot_tolerance = 5: a skater within 5 rest-of-season points of replacement may be streamed too, so forwards just above replacement can be rentals' drops. First set to 10 (the user's call 2026-09-28: 32 drafts, 2024-25 +1.38 +/- 0.32 pts/wk but 2025-26 -0.21 +/- 0.44, not confirmed); 5 since 2026-09-29, the best value in the realistic league (2024-25, 64 drafts: 0, 2.5 and 10 each lose 1.6-2.4 pts/wk; Season/README.md). Every other value equals strategy.json (verify.py 'live strategy'). adddrop.goalie_absence = true (the user's call 2026-09-30, a correctness fix): an injured goalie's window value counts games from his expected return, as a skater's ROS rate already does; realistic league 2024-25, 32 drafts: +0.23 +/- 0.26 pts/wk, changed only 2 of 32 drafts. adddrop.rate_source = 'blend' (the user's call 2026-10-06, on neutral results): a skater's rest-of-season rate is the preseason board (scaled to the model's level) and the model weighted by his games played, board weight 7/(7+GP) (Decisions/valuation.py BLEND_GAMES) -- one 4:29 injury-exit game had cut Jake Sanderson from 309 to 164 rest-of-season points and the espn-la plan rented him away; realistic league 2024-25, beagles, 56 drafts: +0.94 +/- 0.84 pts/wk, win +0.016 +/- 0.018 (halves +2.05 / -0.17), moves unchanged; confirmed 2025-26, 56 drafts: reverting to ros -4.19 +/- 1.01 pts/wk, both halves negative. streaming.restarts = 3 (the user's call 2026-10-06, on neutral results): when the week plan leaves moves unspent, it is rebuilt without each held pickup's team-day in turn and a rebuild worth more (lineup points less bars) is kept (Decisions/weekplan.py WeekPlanner._restart) -- the espn-la plan of 2026-10-07 held Foerster all week and stranded three moves (+5.5) while the week without PHI chained five rentals (+7.2); with it, +6.8. espn-la 2024-25, 60 drafts: +0.13 +/- 0.23 pts/wk, win -0.008 +/- 0.008, halves +0.22 / +0.04, 147 moves a season against 146; confirmed 2025-26, 60 drafts: turning it off +0.22 +/- 0.34 pts/wk, win +0.003 +/- 0.012, halves +0.63 / -0.19 -- neutral, not reversed.
